maria (oncall): :rotating_light: Paging — ACME reported degraded API RPCs over their Private VPN to us-east1. Customers seeing 502/timeout. I see BGP withdraws from our DX peer and ECMP causing traffic to fall into an unresponsive path. Root cause unknown, escalating.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-302 — Severity: Sev2. Notifying oncall channel and paging ryan as backup.

ryan (oncall-backup): On it. Sharing initial checks: `bgp summary` shows neighbor 10.10.0.254 flapping (est/handshake changes). Primary DX circuit shows 30% packet loss in last 5m. Can we confirm whether this correlates with route withdrawals to 172.31.0.0/16?

khalid (net-eng): Confirmed — we see route to 172.31.0.0/16 oscillating between two next-hops: dx1 (preferred) and dx2 (backup). dx1 intermittent withdraws, dx2 accepts but has higher latency. ECMP hash seems to load balance across both and some flows are hitting a misconfigured transit device on dx2.

jin (sre): Customer impact: our healthchecks on their private endpoints show 15-40% 502 across pods; some requests time out after 10s. We have some retries in the product layer but customer SLA affected.

sarah (cust-success): I told ACME support we've escalated to networking and are working on mitigation. They asked for ETA and asked if we can fail traffic to the backup circuit fully.

maria (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) prefer dx2 by prepending on dx1 to drain traffic from dx1. 2) if that fails, apply temporary static route for ACME prefix pointing at dx2. 3) continue diagnostics on the transit box.

khalid (net-eng): Doing prepends on dx1 now: `set bgp community 65535:6666 local-prepend 3` — applying to session to ACME peer. Pushing in 1m.

deploy-bot: bgp-change: config push to router-east1 succeeded (hash: a1b2c3). No restarts.

ryan (oncall-backup): After prepend, traffic distribution shifted — tcpdump on edge shows 85% flow via dx2 now. Customer errors dropped from 40% -> 6% in last 2m. :thumbsup: 

khalid (net-eng): Still seeing a few residual errors, tracing a sample flow shows TTL expired through transit-hop-3 on dx2 path. That indicates a possible MTU or route loop on provider side. Escalating to transit vendor NOC, opening TAC ticket.

sarah (cust-success): ACME asked for a status note for their ops team. Drafting: "We observed BGP instability on primary DX causing asymmetric routing; we've shifted traffic to alternate circuit and are partnering with transit provider for a full fix."

jin (sre): Monitoring — application 5xxs down to baseline ~1.2%. Keeping incident open until vendor confirms stable for 30m.

khalid (net-eng): Vendor acknowledged and fixed a misconfig on their transit switch. They removed a bad policy that rewrote next-hop for some ECMP flows. Vendor reports 20:47 UTC fix.

maria (oncall): Verified end-to-end: BGP sessions stable for 12m, healthchecks green, customer reports normal behavior. I'll do a handoff to oncall rotation item: assign to `net-eng` for postmortem and follow-up with transit vendor.

ryan (oncall-backup): Taking postmortem owner. Will collect BGP dumps, traceroutes, and timeline. Tentative action items: 1) add route dampening thresholds for this customer, 2) document emergency failover playbook (static route script), 3) run chaos test to ensure ECMP resilience.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED INC-2026-302 — Closed by maria (oncall). Duration: 00:37: -- monitoring for 30m before final close.

maria (oncall): Thanks everyone. Will circulate PM notes and assign follow-ups. :coffee:
